name: fast_dev
purpose: Representative train subset for quick prompt iteration under home-server TPS limits. Not a sealed-test substitute.
selection_rationale: Chronic hard cases from Night 1 ladder: cicd_invented, isp_invented, llm_real, payments_real
v015 T2 disclosure-prone cases: cloud_invented, registry_invented (also llm_real, payments_real)
Mix of invented (4) and real (2) brands; six distinct categories
Intentionally excludes easier/redundant category twins to cut wall-clock ~7x vs full 14×samples=3

recommended_iteration_grid.note: Run full train 14×samples=3 only for confirm/freeze, not every edit

sealed_test_policy: Do not shrink or iterate on sealed test during creator loop. Sealed remains the frozen 6-scenario test split; use samples=1 only for rare smoke, never for prompt edits.
